hints.title: Range Parsing
hints.text: Parse the starting column, starting row, ending column, and ending row from the string.

hints.title: Nested Iteration
hints.text: Iterate column characters from start col to end col, and row numbers from start row to end row.

hints.title: Ordering Rule
hints.text: The problem requires column-major output: process each column completely before advancing to the next column.

hints.title: Complete Cell Generator

complexity.notes: Every cell in the specified range is constructed and appended once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Row-major iteration violates the required column-major output sequence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output array stores R * C strings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clear parsing and correct column-major loop order.
